title: Palas Gilaas Miroir
intro: Naatde e leydi woɗɗundi, ndi jawdi e teddeendi ɗo naange rewetee e nokku Tagɗo ɗum. Ɓataake ina ara ina jogii noddaango ngo waawataa yejjiteede, yahdu fuɗɗotoo ko feewde e ñaawirde ɓurnde mawnude e ko yi’aa ko adii. Ko ɗoon, illusion maa feeñ e floor fooɗanoowo gite, sahaa laaɓɗo maa waylu huunde fof.
clues: Mi laamiima leydi kesiri ndi yimɓe mum cujji naange lomtii Alla.
Mi heɓii ɓataake tedduɗo ina nodda mi hoto mi toownu hoore am kono mi ara e ɗooftaare Alla.
Mi naamndii diiso am, mi suɓii dipolomasi ko adii, neldude dokkal ngam ƴeewde neldoowo oo.
Mi arii e Suleymaani, jappeere am ndee hollitaama mi ina 6eydoo 6uu6de ngam jarribaade anndinde mi.
Mi naatii e galle laamorɗo toowɗo mo leydi mum gilaasi ɓuuɓndi mi sikkaani so ina wona ndiyam luggiɗam.
Mi anndinii ɗooftaare am e Sileymaani e Alla, joom winndereeji.

identity.label: Hol ko ngonmi?
options: Debbo Muusaa
Debbo Abu Lahab
Debbo Nuuhu
Bilqis, Laamɗo leydi Saba
Zuleykha, Debbo Al-Aziiz

trial.label: Ñaawoore/Kewu
options: Liɗɗi mawɗi ɓuuɓɗi e nder lugge maayo
Fiyi duuɓi ñawu e majjude ɓesngu
Yamiraama sakkanaade ɓiɗɗo giɗaaɗo e nder koyɗol
Foondiraama e jappeere laamu ɓuuɓnde e palaas gilaas
Wertaa e yiite ngulnge ngam ɓuuɓnude sanamuuji
trial.answer: Foondiraama e jappeere laamu ɓuuɓnde e palaas gilaas

location.label: Elemen keyɗo
options: Laana kaa mahii dow ndiyam
Ngaska ɓuuɓka ɗaaniiɓe
Leydi palaas kristal (Sarh)
Maayo Niil e sahaa eggugol ngol
Jeyngol ngol sanamuuji peewni

outcome.label: Keeɓal
options: Waɗii leydi e jawdi am
Heddii e keefeeraagal halkaama e leñol am
Sottinaama e Sileymaan faade e Alla joom winndereeji
Njokkii e nder maayo nde o woni e rewde gooŋɗinɓe
Waɗiima hayre ngam ƴattaade ñalawma sabaabu
outcome.answer: Sottinaama e Sileymaan faade e Alla joom winndereeji

arabic: فَلَمَّا جَآءَتْ قِيلَ أَهَـٰكَذَا عَرْشُكِ ۖ قَالَتْ كَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ ۚ وَأُوتِينَا ٱلْعِلْمَ مِن قَبْلِهَا وَكُنَّا مُسْلِمِينَ
verse: So when she arrived, it was said [to her], "Is your throne like this?" She said, "[It is] as though it was it." [Solomon said], "And we were given knowledge before her, and we have been Muslims [in submission to Allāh]. (27:42)
